# Toast

Short in-app alerts for context changes, the overload warning and break prompts, plus how the same messages look as Android notifications.

`CLR.Toast` · Coaching

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.Toast title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.Toast" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (ToastProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `string` |  |
| `body` | `string` |  |
| `icon` | `ComponentType<LucideProps>` |  |
| `context` | `"deep_focus" \| "shallow_work" \| "stuck" \| "fatigue" \| "recovering" \| "unknown"` | Colours the icon tile with a context's soft fill. |
| `tone` | `'accent' \| 'positive' \| 'caution' \| 'critical' \| 'rest' \| 'neutral'` |  |
| `actions` | `{ label: string; onClick: () => void; primary?: boolean }[]` |  |
| `duration` | `number \| null` | ms before auto-dismiss. Default 6000; overload and break prompts stay until acted on (pass null). |
| `onClose` | `() => void` |  |
